title: Going Beyond State-Reaching: Learning Abstractions for Intrinsically Motivated Option Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.36473v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal abstraction via options can improve exploration in large environments. However, existing option discovery algorithms find subgoals that target all aspects of the state simultaneously. This state-reaching approach produces options that only apply in narrow regions of the state-space, eventually causing an explosion in the number of options that overwhelms the agent, and impedes progress on its primary task of reward maximization. We introduce an algorithm that instead identifies a small, relevant subset of features for each subgoal, yielding options that generalize broadly and accelerate exploration. Our approach learns abstract, transferrable options and achieves rapid exploration in three sparse-reward, image-based domains, including the Atari game MontezumasRevenge.

translated_title: 超越状态到达：面向内在动机驱动的选项发现的学习抽象方法
translated_abstract: 通过选项进行时间抽象可以改善大型环境中的探索。然而，现有的选项发现算法所寻找的子目标会同时针对状态的所有方面。这种“状态到达”式的做法导致产生的选项仅适用于状态空间中的狭窄区域，最终造成选项数量的爆炸式增长，使智能体不堪重负，并阻碍其在奖励最大化这一主要任务上的进展。我们提出了一种新算法，该算法改为为每个子目标识别一个小而相关的特征子集，从而产生具有广泛泛化能力并能加速探索的选项。我们的方法能够学习抽象且可迁移的选项，并在三个稀疏奖励、基于图像的领域中实现了快速探索，其中包括雅达利游戏《蒙特祖玛的复仇》。
tldr: 该论文提出一种新算法，通过为每个子目标仅识别少量相关特征（而非到达完整状态）来发现选项，从而学习到可广泛泛化且可迁移的抽象选项，在包括《蒙特祖玛的复仇》在内的稀疏奖励环境中实现了快速探索，避免了选项数量爆炸的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an algorithm that discovers options by identifying a small, relevant subset of features for each subgoal instead of reaching entire states, yielding broadly generalizable and transferable abstract options that enable rapid exploration in sparse-reward environments, including Montezuma's Revenge, while avoiding option explosion.
